title: Card Deck Printer
hints:
Unicode suits on Windows
Use letters `C D H S` if `♣` shows as garbage, or run `chcp 65001` in the console first.
requirements: `enum class Suit { clubs, diamonds, hearts, spades, count };`
`enum class Rank { ace, two, ..., king, count };`
`void printCard(const Card&)` and `int cardValue(const Card&)` (Blackjack values)
Nested loops over both enums using the `count` sentinel
